test_coverage_notes: Typical test coverage for CheckCancel would be in unit/integration tests for transaction processing, e.g., 'CheckCancel_test.cpp', 'Transactor_test.cpp', or broader transaction suite files. Tests should cover: non-existent Check (tecNO_ENTRY), expired Check (anyone can cancel), not expired (only source/destination can cancel), directory removal failures (tefBAD_LEDGER, usually unreachable), and owner count adjustment. Gaps: No validation in preflight (could be tested for completeness), and error paths in doApply are marked LCOV_EXCL (excluded from coverage, likely not tested).
